name: Microsoft Clipchamp
description: Microsoft Clipchamp is a browser-based video editor for recording, editing, captioning, composing, and exporting videos for personal and Microsoft 365 work accounts.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft does not publish a supported Clipchamp automation resource in Microsoft Graph v1.0 or a current Clipchamp developer API contract. Relay mounts no connection or tools and does not substitute browser automation, undocumented endpoints, or generic file access for editor control.

blocked.label: Connect Microsoft Clipchamp
blocked.description: Relay has no supported Clipchamp authentication and API contract to connect.

blocked.label: Read Clipchamp projects
blocked.description: Projects, timelines, media, recordings, captions, transcripts, templates, brand kits, and exports are unavailable.

blocked.label: Edit or export with Clipchamp
blocked.description: Recording, editing, captioning, rendering, exporting, sharing, deletion, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Microsoft publishes a supported Clipchamp automation API and authentication contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Clipchamp connection or tools are mounted without a supported public automation API.
No Clipchamp connection or tools are mounted without a supported public automation API.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft's current Clipchamp documentation covers interactive product workflows but does not publish a supported automation API, OAuth scope set, resource model, or lifecycle contract. Clipchamp is not a documented Microsoft Graph v1.0 resource.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Clipchamp unavailable until Microsoft publishes a supported production automation API with exact authentication, project ownership, media handling, rendering, export, retention, revocation, and rate-limit contracts. Do not use browser automation or undocumented endpoints.

evidence.supports: Microsoft's current Clipchamp documentation describes interactive recording, editing, captioning, storage, and export workflows rather than a developer automation API.
Microsoft's supported Graph v1.0 endpoint reference does not document a Clipchamp resource or editor automation API.
Microsoft states that Graph v1.0 contains generally available production APIs and that production applications should not depend on beta APIs.
A Microsoft community support response notes that a former Clipchamp API no longer appears to be generally available and directs users to current product support resources.
